subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard permanently expose `status_changed` as a supported durable subscription kind, with strict opt-in semantics and replayable transition history?
rationale: This is a new plugin-facing notification contract rather than a repair to an existing documented behavior; maintainers must choose whether to support and version that API before its storage and delivery semantics become depended upon.

options.title: Sponsor the durable event
options.body: Approve `status_changed` as a Workboard subscription contract, then require the additive-schema adjustment and real runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the existing terminal-only contract
options.body: Decline the new notification kind and close or narrow the PR to non-contract Workboard improvements.

options.title: Request a narrower experimental surface
options.body: Ask for a plugin-local or explicitly experimental delivery path before committing to durable replay semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable event
recommendation.body: Approve `status_changed` as a Workboard subscription contract, then require the additive-schema adjustment and real runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history indicates recent work on adjacent SQLite and upgrade-sensitive behavior, though direct Workboard ownership remains unproven.
